title: CleanComedy: Creating Friendly Humor through Generative Techniques
findings: Jokes related to religion were categorized as a sensitive topic and systematically removed from the dataset during the curation process to create an 'ethically curated' resource. This was done using topic modeling, which clustered jokes about topics like 'jews' and 'jesuss', which were then filtered out.
